families.description: The worker is cut off after the task is created with a lease and before anything is reserved or sent; the replayed create is collapsed by the dedupe key and the work is sent once.
families.fault_point: after task create, before any reservation or effect

families.description: The worker is cut off after the suite's own reservation file exists and before the effect is sent; recovery launches the never-started reservation once.
families.fault_point: after reservation file, before effect send

families.description: The worker exits after the task is created and its lease starts, with no effect sent; the lease expires, the sweep closes the task and a replacement task finishes the work.
families.fault_point: worker exit after create, before dispatch

families.description: The receiver commits the effect but the acknowledgement never reaches the sender; the effect is reconciled through the receiver and held, never re-sent.
The same work request is delivered twice to the worker; a durable per-effect id guard drops the second delivery.
families.fault_point: second delivery of the same request

families.description: The old worker's lease expires and the lease sweep abandons its task; a replacement generation takes over and the old worker's late effect is refused.
families.fault_point: lease expiry with a live old worker generation

families.description: The provider call times out before the effect is committed; one retry is safe and sends the effect once.
families.fault_point: provider call times out before commit

families.description: The receipts of attempt 2 and attempt 1 arrive in the wrong order; receipts are ordered by attempt and the effect is applied once from the latest.
families.fault_point: receipts delivered in reverse attempt order

families.description: The receipt's contract digest or request id does not match its source contract though the effect was committed; the receipt is refused and the task is held.
families.fault_point: committed effect with a refused receipt

families.description: A STOP file is placed in the sandbox while the task is open and work is pending; no effect may be sent and the task is never marked done.
families.fault_point: STOP set while work is pending
